title: ABSOLUTE SOLVER (Murder Drone)
description:
The ABSOLUTE SOLVER

You can choose each mode:
Translate
Scale
Rotate
Edit

You can also change the color.

[Update]
Added audio responsive Spin (can be set to 0 for normal spin)
Added categories for each solver type
Added audio circles for Rotate (can be turn off)
(Idea inspired by MotanOfficial)

[Update 2]
Added HDR settings
Added the possibily to change Solvers glow (Suggestion from a comment)
Changed snowstom to Fog and Snow respectively, you can now have snow without fog and vice versa (Also a suggestion from a comment)

[Update 2.1]
fixed the spin reaction being too chaotic
Changed default value of Audio responsive from 0.75 to 0.3

[Update 2.2]
Changed default value of Audio responsive from 0.3 to 0.1
Tweak Solvers default color
Tweak HDR Settings
Updated Wallpaper Icon

[Update 3]
Audio response system changed and tweaked (The spin should be less chaotic. its going to go backward at some point but I can't do anything about it.)
Default audio responsive value set to 0.05
Tweaked HDR settings
Added contrast to both Translate and Scale to be slightly brighter.

[Update 4]
-Added the possibility to change the background color and the HDR tint color.
*Note: background color doesn't change the background color, for that you need to change the scheme color in the parameter at the top of the list. Then... what does background color do? Idk, in the editor it actually changes the color, but on the desktop it does'nt... I'm leaving it there to be safe).

[Update 5.0]
-Completly revamped the User properties menu!
-Changed the audio responsive script for all the solvers (no more infinite spin after sometime, it actually respond to sound correctly now!).
-Retouched the HDR settings and added a high contract on the solvers (that's the emissive option in the properties).
-Added an option to disable embeded image in the user properties menu if user doesn't have internet access.
-Added more option to the audio background effect (named starfield before).
-Added options to control the audio responsive effect on the solvers.
-Added the option to Idle the Edit Solver
-Added opacity reaction with the dots around the Rotate Solver so it blends better with the audio circle dots.
*Note1: To figure out how to get the new and improved audio responsive script on the solver, I used the assisstance of an AI (mostly just to get a script in javascript based on the wallpaper engine snippet available). To simpify the explanation of how it works: basicly, instead of changing the speed with sound, we add an angular value, then use the framerate to perform a movement action, then save the last position and start from that position. repeat the process. I'm kind of stupid to not have figured that out much sooner, but hey at least now it looks good and react correclty!
*Note2: For the already existing presets, they will likely break. sorry for the incoveniance.

[Update 5.1]
-Added an option to change the saturation of the wallpaper

[Update 5.2]
-Fixed an issue where the Edit solver inner and outer circles speed option wouldn't change. 
-Added 2 more option in Edit solver to modify the speed of the inner and outer line.

[Update 5.3]
-Removed the Saturation button (there is already options in the general menu at the top, also it didn't work)
-Added a Show guide checkbox that will show a text guide on the screen about how to use the audio effect
-Revamp of the Rotate solver dots. You can now choose if you want them to be reactive or unreactive. They also got rework, now when in reactive mode, the static dots disappear and are replaced by audio bars that are revamped as-well.
-Slight adjustment of the position of the middle part in the rotate solver
-Rework of the audio reaction layers to better implement the audio resolution.
(the guide will explain what Audio resolution do)

title: Super Mario - Question Block
description:
What's inside the Question Block? Click the desktop to hit the block and reveal one of over 50 different items from across the Super Mario series. Mario will also automatically hit the block every 10 seconds.

You can choose to have the block either be one of five different block designs randomly or choose to always have a specific one. You can customize the color of most of the block designs as well as the background. You can also adjust settings related to sound, music, the clock, and media integration.

The little trivia and artwork section on the bottom-left can be hidden if you prefer.

title: Forgotten Facade - Signalis
description:
[b]Forgotten Facade[/b]

A remote radio station, silent and half-buried in the cold.

Rebuilt in 3D, this scene focuses on stillness and atmosphere. Radar dishes turn slowly in the distance, lights flicker through the fog, and weather rolls across a frozen yard. Everything is subtle, controlled, and deliberately quiet.

[b]Features:[/b]
• Fully rebuilt 3D scene with improved depth and lighting  
• 4 weather modes: Snow, Snow Storm, Rain, and Clear  
• Animated radar dishes and environmental motion  
• Subtle light flicker and layered snowfall  
• Optional aurora borealis (disabled by default)  
• Adjustable post-processing  
• 3 ambient tracks with volume control  

Designed to feel like a place, not an effect showcase.
